expected_terminal_postconditions: Ishai has exactly one additional +1/+1 counter after the trigger resolves.

expected_terminal_postconditions: Rograkh is on A’s battlefield with base printed power/toughness 0/1.

Printed mana cost is 0; with zero prior command-zone casts the commander-tax increment is 0.
required_decisions: A casts Rograkh from the command zone.

expected_terminal_postconditions: The legal total cost is exactly the otherwise-applicable total cost plus 3 generic mana.

expected_terminal_postconditions: B=17 life, C=17 life, D=17 life.

Kediss’s added damage is dealt by that commander to each other opponent and is noncombat damage.

expected_terminal_postconditions: After both magecraft triggers resolve, Veyran has +2/+2 until end of turn from this cast.

A has a legal instant spell in hand.

required_decisions: A casts the instant.

expected_terminal_postconditions: Exactly two instances of the other Wizard’s triggered ability are placed/resolved, absent intervening effects.

Harmonic Prodigy does not recursively reapply to its own multiplier effect.
required_decisions: Cause that other Wizard’s triggered ability to trigger once.

expected_terminal_postconditions: B draws exactly one card from the two-card instruction.

expected_terminal_postconditions: Jeska initially has 2 loyalty counters.

The targeted creature’s combat damage to opponent B is tripled by a replacement effect.

Activate Jeska’s 0 ability targeting the 2-power creature.
Attack B with that creature before A’s next turn.

expected_terminal_postconditions: B has lost 2 life from Magma Opus damage.

Choose D’s two permanents as the tap targets.

expected_terminal_postconditions: B’s commander spell is countered; Wash Away was not required to use cleave.

expected_terminal_postconditions: Exactly two of the seven looked-at cards are in A’s hand; the other five are on the bottom in A’s chosen order.

From the top seven library cards choose two to put into hand and order the other five on the bottom.

expected_terminal_postconditions: A controls the spell copy on the stack/resolution path with the chosen legal target; no cast-trigger is generated merely by creating the copy.

The copy is created on the stack and is not cast.

Choose a legal new target for the created copy.

expected_terminal_postconditions: The relevant B/C/D artifacts are destroyed; A’s artifact remains.

On resolution choose all five tapped lands to untap.

An effect will make A draw two cards sequentially.

Its power/toughness continuously equal A’s current hand size.

expected_terminal_postconditions: B is dealt 4 damage by Kaervek before the triggering spell resolves if no responses intervene.
